name: Resolve Terraform Backend
description: "Compute TF_STATE_BUCKET and TF_STATE_TABLE for the current TG_ENV and AWS account."

inputs:
  tg_env:
    description: "Environment name (dev/prod). If empty, uses TG_ENV env var or 'dev'."
    required: false
    default: ""
  aws_region:
    description: "AWS region. If empty, uses AWS_REGION env var or 'us-east-1'."
    required: false
    default: ""

outputs:
  tf_state_bucket:
    description: "Resolved S3 bucket name for Terraform remote state"
    value: ${{ steps.backend.outputs.tf_state_bucket }}
  tf_state_table:
    description: "Resolved DynamoDB table name for Terraform state locking"
    value: ${{ steps.backend.outputs.tf_state_table }}
  account_id:
    description: "AWS Account ID used for the backend"
    value: ${{ steps.backend.outputs.account_id }}

runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    - id: backend
      shell: bash
      run: |
        # Resolve env name
        ENV_INPUT="${{ inputs.tg_env }}"
        if [ -z "${ENV_INPUT}" ]; then
          ENV_INPUT="${TG_ENV:-dev}"
        fi

        # Resolve region
        REGION_INPUT="${{ inputs.aws_region }}"
        if [ -z "${REGION_INPUT}" ]; then
          REGION_INPUT="${AWS_REGION:-us-east-1}"
        fi

        case "${ENV_INPUT}" in
          dev|prod) ;;
          *)
            echo "Unsupported TG_ENV=${ENV_INPUT}"
            exit 1
            ;;
        esac

        echo "Using environment=${ENV_INPUT}"
        echo "Using AWS_REGION=${REGION_INPUT}"

        ACCOUNT_ID=$(aws sts get-caller-identity \
          --query Account \
          --output text \
          --region "${REGION_INPUT}")

        STATE_BUCKET="tfstate-demo-${ENV_INPUT}-${ACCOUNT_ID}"
        LOCK_TABLE="tfstate-locks-${ACCOUNT_ID}"

        echo "::add-mask::${ACCOUNT_ID}"
        echo "::add-mask::${STATE_BUCKET}"
        echo "::add-mask::${LOCK_TABLE}"
        echo "Resolved Terraform backend for environment=${ENV_INPUT}; values are masked."

        # Export as environment variables for subsequent steps
        echo "TF_STATE_BUCKET=${STATE_BUCKET}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        echo "TF_STATE_TABLE=${LOCK_TABLE}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        echo "ACCOUNT_ID=${ACCOUNT_ID}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

        # Export as outputs
        echo "tf_state_bucket=${STATE_BUCKET}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        echo "tf_state_table=${LOCK_TABLE}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        echo "account_id=${ACCOUNT_ID}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
